meta.name: lark-workflow-standup-report
meta.description: 日程待办摘要：编排 calendar +agenda 和 task +get-my-tasks，生成指定日期的日程与未完成任务摘要。适用于了解今天/明天/本周的安排。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总日程与待办，生成每日工作摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解当日日程和未完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize calendar and tasks for daily standup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of your schedule and pending tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读取你的飞书日历与未完成待办,按指定日期汇总成一份摘要:日程表格、待办清单,以及会议数、冲突提醒和空闲时段小结。需先以 user 身份授权 calendar 和 task。
howto.when: 当你想了解今天、明天或本周的安排时触发,例如说「今天有什么安排」「早报摘要」「standup report」等。

say.text: 帮我看看今天有什么安排
say.note: 生成今天的日程与待办摘要

say.text: 明天有什么会和未完成的事?

say.note: 汇总本周剩余日程与待办

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude reads your Lark calendar and unfinished tasks and compiles a summary for a given date: an agenda table, a to-do list, plus counts, conflict alerts and free slots. Requires user-identity auth for calendar and task.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to know today's, tomorrow's or this week's schedule, e.g. "what's on today", "standup report", "morning summary".

say_en.text: Show me what's on my schedule today
say_en.note: Builds today's agenda and to-do summary

say_en.text: What meetings and open tasks do I have tomorrow?
What's left on my calendar this week?
say_en.note: Summarizes the rest of the week
